claim_boundary: post-hoc exploratory validation-only component evidence; no test data, no live simulation, no change to frozen planning-study/3E evidence, no universal or causal feature-importance claim

population.ranking_eligibility: fully observed context (every candidate R_valid and T_valid) with at least one Y-positive action, exactly as ranker_validate._ranking_metrics

compatibility.purpose: frozen-checkpoint inference for the reference gate and experiments A, B, C, and E

training.purpose: same-runtime D0/D1/D2 retraining and their validation evaluation

reference_gate.rule: abort A, B, and E unless each three-seed mean rounds to the listed value at five decimals; record per-seed values and whether they are identical to the frozen per-seed reports

ranking_contract.flattening: candidate-major over the stored candidates, then direction order +Z,-Z,+X,-X,+Y,-Y
ranking_contract.sort: decreasing score; exact ties by part-ID string (the planner's action_planner.scored_actions order), then direction order +Z,-Z,+X,-X,+Y,-Y; part rankings (B) break part-score ties by part-ID string
ranking_contract.mean_first_feasible_rank: 1-based position of the first Y-positive action, averaged over ranking-eligible contexts
ranking_contract.seed_aggregation: per-seed context mean, then mean over seeds 0/1/2
ranking_contract.reference_gate_code: unchanged frozen ranker_validate._ranking_tables, which breaks exact ties by stored candidate order

A.name: score ablation without retraining

variants.A2: P_T(p), identical for all six directions of a part

A.A2_interpretation: descriptive stability-only control, not a practical planner score

B.name: action-granularity ablation without retraining
B.part_score: max over directions of P_Y(p,d) = P_R(p,d) * P_T(p); parts ordered by decreasing part score, ties by part ID

variants.B1: FAST part order, then fixed direction order +Z,-Z,+X,-X,+Y,-Y within each part
variants.B2: FAST part order, then the frozen train-only direction prior within each part (decreasing rate, ties by fixed direction order)

B.interpretation: grouping FAST actions by part under fixed or prior within-part direction policies; not a pure causal granularity effect and not a reimplementation of Cebulla et al.

C.name: complete-label replay on small validation assemblies
C.population: the 115 validation assemblies with 3-6 parts listed in the closure manifest
C.search: fast.action_planner.run_action_dfs unchanged: depth-first search, stored pose order, stability reuse within a state/pose/part, skip of remaining directions after a stored T=false, mandatory validation of every attempted action
C.pose_order: stored poses.json order (pose-000, pose-001, ...) of each reachable state
C.budgets: k*(N-1) action validations for k in 1, 2, 4, 8; success at k iff solution_action_validation <= k*(N-1)
C.null_label_rule: a null stored R or T counts as one non-accepted validation; it is never converted to false or skipped
C.fast_scoring: single-context forward of the frozen checkpoint on the materialized graph record with the frozen normalization, matching planner_integration.FactorizedRanker

asap_heur_out.ranker: plan_sequence.generate_budgeted_sim_labels._heur_out_ranker on raw OBJ geometry, fixed directions

heur_out_direction_prior.ranker: outside-in part order with the frozen direction prior

cebulla_gcn.ranker: frozen Cebulla-style GCN part logits, ties by part ID, fixed directions

C.reporting: success rate per method and budget averaged over seeds; paired differences against fast_A0 with the frozen plan restricted to the small-tier block after proving exactly 115 small draws per replicate

exact_equality: ordered attempted actions (state, pose, part, direction)
R and T labels of each validation
redmax_rollouts and stability_restarts, compared with stored oracle_rollout_count
excluded_from_equality: ordered_action_list_sha256 and score floats (reported, not gated)
real_equivalence_gate.disclosure: real replay-to-live equivalence on one five-part training assembly; multiple FAST traces are runtime repetitions

synthetic_fixtures: rejected directions before an accepted action
stability cache hit for multiple directions of one candidate in one state/pose
failed continuation followed by backtracking and an alternate accepted branch
null R and null T counted as non-accepted validations
budget exhaustion exactly at a transition boundary and inside a failed branch
C.wording: complete-label replay on small validation assemblies; not live planning, simulator evidence, or medium/large evidence

D.name: same-runtime feature ablation with retraining
D.mask_rule: indices derived by name from cad_features.ACTION_FEATURES; fail if names or order differ; slice the frozen training-only action normalization with the same indices; node features, graph, targets, masks, and losses unchanged

protocol.architecture: graph_transformer factorized R/T heads with the action-head input width set by the mask; module construction order unchanged
protocol.data_order: numpy.RandomState(seed*1000003+epoch) over the 1,703 training inventory rows; contexts canonical
protocol.loss: ranker_models.model_loss with frozen component assembly counts
protocol.selection: maximize (validation Success@1, first-feasible MRR, Y average precision, -epoch) over epochs, as ranker_train.train
protocol.validation_evaluation: selected checkpoint re-evaluated on cuda:0 in the training runtime with ranker_train.predict

D.frozen_checkpoints_role: context and compatibility reference only, not the causal control
D.execution_order: A/B/C/E pretraining gate; D0-seed-0 smoke; D0-seed-0; D1-seed-0 and D2-seed-0; seed-0 status report and pause; seeds 1 and 2 as matched rounds only after a recorded continuation
D.concurrency_rule: at most three concurrent jobs, only if projected aggregate peak VRAM < 0.80 * 32 GB, aggregate host RAM < 0.75 * WSL-visible RAM, and >= 4 logical processors per job while retaining 2 for the system; compare measured epoch throughput with one process
D.stop_rule: a stop after seed 0 may depend only on time, resources, or machine availability; never on effect sign or magnitude

E.name: prediction-quality table
E.threshold: predicted positive iff probability >= 0.5 on uncalibrated probabilities; no tuning
E.denominators: TP/TN/FP/FN/unresolved as shares of all labels of the target (resolved plus null); accuracy, precision, and recall over resolved labels; validity masks R_valid, T_valid, Y_valid
E.seed_aggregation: per seed and mean over seeds 0/1/2
E.timing_row: omitted; the closure transfers no medium/large label summaries

statistics.estimator: per replicate and seed: ratio of summed assembly numerators to summed assembly denominators; mean over available seeds; difference of variant minus control
statistics.tier_rows: the same replicate rows restricted to that tier's stratum block
statistics.intervals: exploratory 95% percentile intervals; no p-values or confirmatory significance
statistics.single_seed_fallback: report seed 0 only; show the historical frozen three-seed spread only as context

telemetry.isolation: separate mirror process tails the local authoritative epoch log; the training process never imports wandb
logged: action feature names and input width
telemetry.fallback: offline mode on any W&B failure; training never waits on or aborts for telemetry

amendments.reason: a fail-closed guard in the first offline run (no output written, no metric computed or viewed) showed that stored candidate order is ascending part ID only for small-tier contexts; medium/large contexts store label-collection order. The protocol requires ties by part identifier, then frozen direction order, as in the planner, so ties are now ordered explicitly instead of by storage order.
